summary: tcp_reset_hosttest.c with seven faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/network/tcp/tcp.c

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && cp tests/host/tcp_reset_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/tests/host/ && exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat ${WORK}/t/tests/host/tcp_reset_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/network/tcp/rcvwnd.c tests/host/compat/kheap_host.c tests/host/compat/pressure_host.c -o ${WORK}/tcp_reset_hosttest

faults.name: in-window
faults.summary: a reset inside the window taken as if at the next sequence number

lines: a reset inside the window but not at the next sequence number closes nothing

faults.name: out-of-window
faults.summary: a reset outside the window answered

lines: a reset outside the window is dropped without an answer

faults.name: listener-gone
